plan.failureSummary: Cached deterministic execution failed to resolve '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']' because the page rendered a different survey field set ("Set 2").
observedIndicators: Deterministic mode replayed step targeting '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']' which did not exist on the current page
Failure screenshot shows 'Set 2' rendered on the survey form with 'Occupation' dropdown and checkboxes instead of age radio buttons
Historical runs show periodic failures in deterministic mode that recover on retry when cache is updated

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page AI cache and retry the automation flow to allow the AI agent to interact with the updated dynamic field set ('Set 2') autonomously.

plan.notes: The test ran in DETERMINISTIC mode using cached AI tool steps from a previous execution. The live application rendered 'Set 2' of the survey form (visible in the live screenshot header), which replaced the age group radio buttons with an Occupation dropdown and interest checkboxes. Because the cached selector was no longer present in the DOM, the deterministic click step failed. Clearing the Page AI cache will allow the autonomous agent to inspect the live page and dynamically adapt to the active question set.
